description: Write a long report, or a new version of one, as a live page. Use it when you have more to tell than about three short chat messages: a long result, findings, a plan, a review. The full text (markdown: headings, tables, lists, links, images by URL) goes into the report; the chat gets one line. Returns the report's id, its page address and `reference`: send `reference` as its own line in your message, after at most one short sentence, and never paste the report's text into the chat. To change a report, call again with its id: the new text becomes the current version and the earlier versions stay readable.
name: report

card.description: The work card the report belongs to, if any.

goal.description: The goal the report belongs to, if any.

id.description: A report's id (rep_...) to add a new version to it. Omit to write a new report.

private.description: Serve it only to the owner's own session. Set when it is built from the owner's private material.

summary.description: One line (at most 280 characters) that says what the report tells: the line the chat shows.
